ValidationRule.description: If Case record type is "IME SC Case" AND SLA Missed is True AND (Cut Off Time is Changed OR End time Cut off is Changed OR Rush is changed), then do not allow to change the End Time Cut Off.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case", IME_SC_SLA_Missed__c = true, OR( ISCHANGED(IME_SC_Cut_Off_Time__c) , AND( ISCHANGED(End_Time_Cutoff_SLA__c), NOT(IME_SC_Rush__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case has already missed SLA. You cannot enter end cut-off time again.
